videos.title: The Perfect Spacing Framework in UI Design | Figma Tutorial
videos.why: Mizko builds a spacing system in Figma and applies it to real components; compare his scale with the 4 and 8-point values you pick from in lab-spacing.

videos.title: The Easy Way to Pick Perfect Spacing
videos.why: Sajid fixes spacing on real examples step by step, using grouping to decide which gaps should be small and which large; it is the proximity principle from lesson 6 put to work.

podcasts.why: Erik Kennedy of Learn UI Design on his rules for developers who design; from about 7:51 the hosts work through his list, including 'double your whitespace'. The page has a full transcript.

reads.title: The 8-Point Grid
reads.why: Why so many teams size and space everything in multiples of 8, and the difference between the 'hard grid' and 'soft grid' ways of applying it.

reads.title: 7 Rules for Creating Gorgeous UI (2024 update)
reads.why: The first three of Erik Kennedy's rules, ending with 'double your whitespace'; read it with your busiest screen open and try the rule on it.

reads.title: Box Model
reads.why: The four areas of every box (content, padding, border, margin) with clear diagrams; the code side of the box model figure and lab.
